📖 How to use

  1. Enter a date and time.
  2. Pick the source time zone and the target time zone.
  3. The converted time appears instantly.
  4. Scroll down for live clocks in six major time zones.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the time zone conversion work?

The conversion reads your input as wall-clock time in the source zone, converts to UTC, then formats it in the target zone. DST and offsets are handled automatically.

Does it handle daylight saving time?

Yes. The zones list includes the offsets and daylight-saving rules built into the browser via Intl, so DST transitions are handled.

How do the live world clocks work?

The live clocks update every second from your device clock, converted into each zone.
